en.storage: FunnyWork secure account storage is unavailable. Unlock GNOME Keyring or KWallet in your desktop session, then restart FunnyWork.
en.updates: Automatic updates are unavailable on Linux. Install a newer FunnyWork package manually.
en.platformAccount: DeepSeek account sign-in and embedded account pages are unavailable on Linux. Use your FunnyWork account.

zh-CN.storage: FunnyWork 无法安全保存账号。请在桌面会话中解锁 GNOME Keyring 或 KWallet，然后重启 FunnyWork。
zh-CN.updates: Linux 暂不支持自动更新，请手动安装新版 FunnyWork 安装包。
zh-CN.platformAccount: Linux 暂不支持 DeepSeek 账号登录与内嵌账号页面，请使用 FunnyWork 账号。
